messages:
rachel: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. goal: turn the remediation list into concrete tests + owners so we don't regress on the same pattern.

rachel: main pain points to cover: prompt regressions (unexpected token shifts), tail-latency spikes under burst, and KV cache degradation after pod churn.

tom: i'll own prompt-driven tests. approach: collect the 50 highest-impact prompts from the incident, record full system messages + seed, and add a golden-response check that runs in CI. estimate 6 days.

nina: i'll take the burst load scenario and the k8s-restart chaos drill. plan: replicate peak QPS for 5m and simulate rolling restarts of 25% of pods. need a safe test window and eng-sre signoff.

rachel: proposed artifacts per action item: promptset file (jsonl with seed + meta), CI job (pipeline stage), nightly regression job, load-test dashboard, chaos-runbook + postmortem template.

marta: please include acceptance criteria in each ticket. example for prompt test: exact-match for first N tokens OR rouge-l >= 0.93 for blurred checks; fail-ticket if >3 prompts fail.

tom: adding a sample promptset entry schema now:```json
{"id":"inc-2026-01","seed":1234,"system":"assistant: be concise","prompt":"Summarize user query...","expected_prefix":"In summary","tags":["regression","high-priority"]}
```

nina: for the load test, i'll base traffic mix on last 30d p50/p95 shapes. @devops-bot can you export the QPS histogram to the ticket?

devops-bot: exported histograms to https://artifacts.redwood.ai/traffic/inc-2026-hist.tar.gz and attached to ML-REG-204.

rachel: i've opened ML-REG-204 as the umbrella ticket. sub-tasks: ingest promptset, CI stage PR, nightly job, load-sim script, chaos-runbook, SLIs/alerts. link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ML-REG-204

tom: CI snippet i'll add to the repo:```yaml
jobs:
  postmortem-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run_promptset_check --file promptsets/inc-2026.jsonl --model rwd-open-7b --seed 1234
```

marta: SLIs we want monitored: per-prompt pass-rate, median latency for the promptset, p99 tail latency under test load, and KV miss-rate. alert if pass-rate drops below 97% or p99 > 800ms for two consecutive runs.

nina: timeline proposal: promptset ingest + CI PR in 7 days, nightly job + dashboard in 10 days, first dry-run chaos drill in 16 days.

tom: confirm 7 days for promptset. i'll include deterministic seeds and a checksum for the promptset file so CI can verify integrity.

rachel: good. small cost-control note: run heavy-variant models on sampled subset (20%) to bound infra spend. include sampling flag in the nightly config.

marta: on the chaos drill invite please include rollback criteria and contact list for eng-oncall. also cc security for any data access checks.

devops-bot: reminder: ML-REG-183 has 2 open actions older than 5 days. Please update ML-REG-204 with owners to avoid drift.

rachel: i'll shepherd the Jira items and post a short PRD summary to the original postmortem doc. if anyone can't meet the timelines, say so here and we'll replan.

tom: all good from me, ping me if you want the promptset review.

nina: ditto, i'll coordinate with eng-sre on the runbook.

marta: thanks folks 917 i'll lock timelines in ML-REG-204 and schedule a 30m sync next week to unblock questions. closing thread.
